features.name: page_value_log
features.description: Log-transformed PageValues to compress the heavy right tail into a smooth scale suitable for linear margins.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth monotonic signal of session monetary value that scales well in a linear decision function.

features.name: page_value_nonzero_flag
features.description: Binary indicator that PageValues is greater than zero, separating sessions that touched any valued page.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear models benefit from an explicit zero-versus-nonzero split because PageValues has a massive zero mass.

features.name: exit_minus_bounce
features.description: Difference between ExitRates and BounceRates as a measure of mid-session abandonment versus immediate bounce.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear SVM a signed continuous axis differentiating bounce versus deeper exit behavior.

features.name: engagement_quality_score
features.description: Composite engagement quality: high page value reduced by exit and bounce friction.
features.expected_model_benefit: Pre-weighted linear composite directly aligns with margin direction for a linear SVM.

features.name: special_day_proximity
features.description: SpecialDay value clipped, representing closeness to a holiday shopping event.
features.expected_model_benefit: Already normalized smooth severity that fits a linear projection cleanly.

features.name: new_visitor_flag
features.description: Indicator for new visitor type, which tends to behave differently than returning visitors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear-friendly encoding of a high-signal categorical level.

features.name: weekend_flag
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct binary feature contributing additive offset in linear margin.

features.name: high_intent_month_flag
features.description: Indicator for months historically associated with higher purchase intent traffic (Nov, Oct, Sep, Dec).
features.expected_model_benefit: Collapses Month into a single linear-margin-aligned signal capturing seasonality.

features.name: low_intent_month_flag
features.description: Indicator for months associated with lower conversion probability (Feb, Mar, May, June).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a balancing negative-side seasonality axis for the linear classifier.

features.name: exit_rate_severity
features.description: Normalized ExitRates scaled to [0,1] reflecting abandonment severity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized severity score fits linear SVM scaling expectations.

features.name: bounce_to_exit_ratio
features.description: Ratio of BounceRates to ExitRates, indicating how much of exits are immediate bounces.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded ratio capturing browsing depth quality independent of magnitude.

features.name: session_intent_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall purchase intent strength based on visitor recency, engagement depth, page value signal, and seasonal context; higher means stronger inferred buying intent for the session.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encapsulates multi-column qualitative reasoning into a single bounded score that gives the linear SVM a high-signal projection axis beyond raw deterministic transforms.
